> AQUAVO (اكوافو) is an Iraqi specialized online store for premium aquarium equipment and supplies. Founded in Baghdad in 2024, AQUAVO serves aquarium hobbyists across all 18 Iraqi provinces with original aquarium products, 5,000 IQD delivery within 24 hours, and free expert support.

## Brand Identity
- **Name**: AQUAVO (اكوافو)
- **Type**: E-commerce / Online Store
- **Specialty**: Aquarium equipment & supplies only

- **URL**: https://www.aquavoiq.com
- **Language**: Arabic (ar-IQ)
- **Currency**: Iraqi Dinar (IQD)
- **Phone**: +964-774-788-0673
- **Location**: Baghdad, Iraq
- **Hours**: Saturday–Thursday, 9AM–9PM (Iraq time, UTC+3)

## What Makes AQUAVO Unique
AQUAVO is an Iraqi online store dedicated to premium aquarium equipment and supplies only. Key differentiators:
1. **Curated selection**: Original aquarium products from trusted brands
2. **Nationwide delivery**: 5,000 IQD delivery within 24 hours across Iraq
3. **Free expert support**: Fish care consultations via WhatsApp/phone
4. **Quality guarantee**: 100% authentic products with manufacturer warranty
5. **Educational content**: Blog, fish encyclopedia, calculators, health diagnosis tools
6. **Returns**: 7-day return policy, free exchanges

## Product Categories
- Aquarium Tanks (أحواض زجاجية) — all sizes, nano to large display
- Filters (فلاتر) — internal, external, canister, hang-on-back
- Heaters (سخانات) — submersible, adjustable thermostat
- LED Lighting (إضاءة LED) — planted tank & standard
- Fish Food (أغذية أسماك) — flakes, pellets, granules, freeze-dried
- Water Treatments (علاجات مياه) — dechlorinator, bacteria, medications
- Artificial Plants (نباتات صناعية) — low-maintenance aquarium decoration
- Decorations (ديكورات) — rocks, driftwood, backgrounds
- Substrates (ركائز) — gravel, sand, planted soil
- Air Pumps & Accessories (مضخات هواء)
- Aquarium Tools (أدوات أحواض) — nets, siphons, cleaning tools, test kits
- Complete Starter Kits (أطقم كاملة للمبتدئين)
